meta.title: 第29讲 · 被动语态① 自学
meta.subtitle: 自学一遍再上课：什么是被动 → 及物动词才能被动 → 三步转换口诀 → 八种时态 be done → 什么时候用被动 → 综合验收（共 6 关 · 43 题。作业卷留到课后当考试，这里不剧透）

nodes.title: ① 什么是被动语态？
nodes.explain:
英语的语态有两种：

· 主动语态：主语是动作的执行者（谁在做）
· 被动语态：主语是动作的承受者（谁被怎么样）

主动（执行者作主语）被动（承受者作主语）
We talk about the accident.
我们讨论这个事故。		The accident is talked about (by us).
这个事故被我们讨论。
John read the book.
约翰读了这本书。		The book was read (by John).
这本书被约翰读了。

定义：主语是动作的承受者，就叫被动语态。中文里的「被、由、受到、得到」往往对应英文的被动句。

观察上面的例子：被动句其实就是换座位——原来的宾语升格当主语，原来的主语退到 by 后面（有时干脆不出现）。谓语动词则变成 be + 过去分词。

自学方法：先读讲解 → 盖住答案做下面的热身题 → 点「先想再看答案」核对 → 全懂了就点「我学完了」，进入下一关。

general_qs.stem: 下列哪一句是被动语态？
options: Grandpa waters the flowers every morning.
The flowers are watered every morning.
general_qs.explain: B 的主语 the flowers 是浇水动作的承受者（花被浇），谓语 are watered = be + 过去分词，是被动。A 的主语 Grandpa 是执行者（爷爷浇花），是主动。

general_qs.stem: 这张桌子是去年做的。The table __________ __________ last year.（用 make 的适当形式）
general_qs.explain: 桌子是「被做」的承受者 → 用被动；last year 是过去时间 → be 用过去式 was。The table was made last year.

general_qs.stem: 找出这句话里动作的执行者：The window was broken by my little brother.
general_qs.explain: by 后面引出的就是执行者。注意被动句里 by 短语经常整个省略——不知道是谁、或不必说是谁的时候：My bike was stolen last night.（我的自行车昨晚被偷了——小偷是谁不知道。）

nodes.title: ② 只有及物动词才能变被动：rise/raise、sit/seat
nodes.explain:
规则：只有及物动词（后面能接宾语）才有被动形式；不及物动词（主语自己动，不接宾语）没有被动。本讲最爱考两对易混词：

动词及物/不及物意思能不能被动
raise及物（接宾语）举起、提高、增加能：The price is raised. 价格被提高。✓
rise不及物（自己升）上升、起床、升起不能：The price rises. 价格上涨。✗ 无被动
seat及物（接宾语）使……就座能：I was seated in the first row. 我被安排在第一排。✓
sit不及物（自己坐）坐不能：I sat down. 我坐下了。✗ 无被动

记法：rise / sit 是「自己动」——太阳自己升、自己坐下，没人摆布它，所以没有被动；raise / seat 是「摆布别人」——把价格提上去、把客人安排到座位上，有宾语可换位，所以能被动。

变形式也要背熟：

原形过去式过去分词
riseroserisen
raiseraisedraised
sitsatsat
seatseatedseated

注意这两个坑：①「价格上涨」用 has risen（rise 主动完成时），「工资被提高」用 has been raised（raise 被动完成时）；② seat yourself（把自己安顿到座位上）里 seat 也是及物——宾语是 yourself。

下面的练习都是围绕这两对词的新句子——作业卷的题不会在这里出现。
nodes.qs_label: 热身练习：从 rise / raise / sit / seat 中选词并填入正确形式

general_qs.stem: The hot-air balloon ________ (rise) slowly into the sky yesterday morning.
general_qs.explain: 气球「自己升」→ 不及物 rise（无被动）；yesterday morning → 过去式 rose。

general_qs.stem: Please ________ (raise) your hand if you want to ask a question.
general_qs.explain: 「举手」＝把手抬高，your hand 是宾语 → 及物 raise；Please 开头的祈使句 → 原形。

general_qs.stem: In summer, the river ________ (rise) quickly after heavy rain.
general_qs.explain: 河水「自己上涨」→ rise；说的是每年夏天的普遍情况 → 一般现在时，the river 第三人称单数 → rises。

general_qs.stem: We ________ (sit) down around the fire and began to chat.
general_qs.explain: 「自己坐下」→ 不及物 sit；and began 是过去式并列 → sat。

general_qs.stem: The waiter ________ (seat) us near the window just now.
general_qs.explain: 服务员「安排我们入座」，宾语是 us → 及物 seat；just now → 一般过去式 seated。

general_qs.stem: All the visitors ________ (seat) in the meeting room before the talk began.
general_qs.explain: 参观者「被安排入座」→ seat 的被动；before 从句是一般过去时，主句也是过去 → were seated（visitors 复数）。

nodes.title: ③ 主动变被动只要三步（附口诀）
nodes.explain:
以 I use a pen. → A pen is used by me. 为例：

步骤做什么例子
步骤 1原句的宾语 → 变成被动句的主语I use a pen. → A pen …（宾变主）
步骤 2谓语动词 → be + 过去分词（be 的新人称、数随新主语；时态保持原句不变）use → is used（谓变 be done）
步骤 3原句的主语 → 放到 by 后面（主格变宾格：I → me）… by me（主变宾）

口诀：宾变主，主变宾，谓变 be done，时不变，数格必须随被变。

两个易错点：① by 后面用宾格（by me / by him / by us）；② be 的单复数看新主语——A pen is used…，The pens are used…。

下面的练习用同一对主角（猫追老鼠）把八种时态各变一遍——做完你就会发现，被动转换唯一的变化就是 be 的形状，正好给第 ④ 关热身。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习 1：把主动句改成被动句（注意每题不止一格一词）

general_qs.stem:
The cat chases the mouse.
= The mouse __________ __________ __________.
general_qs.answer: The mouse is chased by the cat.
general_qs.explain: chases 一般现在时（三单）→ 被动 be 用 is；the mouse 单数。宾变主：mouse 当主语；chase → chased。

general_qs.stem:
The cat chased the mouse.
= The mouse __________ __________ __________.
general_qs.answer: The mouse was chased by the cat.
general_qs.explain: chased 一般过去时 → 被动 be 用过去式 was（新主语 the mouse 单数）。

general_qs.stem:
The cat will chase the mouse.
= The mouse __________ __________ __________.
general_qs.answer: The mouse will be chased by the cat.
general_qs.explain: will chase 一般将来时 → will be chased。注意 will 后面必须有 be，不能丢（×will chased）。

general_qs.stem:
The cat would chase the mouse.
= The mouse __________ __________ __________.
general_qs.answer: The mouse would be chased by the cat.
general_qs.explain: would chase 过去将来时 → would be chased，同样保留 be。

general_qs.stem:
The cat is chasing the mouse.
= The mouse __________ __________ __________.
general_qs.answer: The mouse is being chased by the cat.
general_qs.explain: is chasing 现在进行时 → is being chased。进行时被动最易错：being 不能丢（×is chased / ×is been chased）。

general_qs.stem:
The cat was chasing the mouse.
= The mouse __________ __________ __________.
general_qs.answer: The mouse was being chased by the cat.
general_qs.explain: was chasing 过去进行时 → was being chased。

general_qs.stem:
The cat has chased the mouse.
= The mouse __________ __________ __________.
general_qs.answer: The mouse has been chased by the cat.
general_qs.explain: has chased 现在完成时 → has been chased。完成时被动的 been 不能丢（×has chased / ×has being chased）。

general_qs.stem:
The cat had chased the mouse.
= The mouse __________ __________ __________.
general_qs.answer: The mouse had been chased by the cat.
general_qs.explain: had chased 过去完成时 → had been chased。

nodes.title: ④ 八种时态的被动：一张 be done 万能表
nodes.explain:
被动语态的基本构成：be + 过去分词（done）。be 本身没有词义，但要随时态、人称、数变化。把这张表背熟，所有被动题都是填表题：

时态主动被动
一般现在时do / doesam/is/are + done
一般过去时didwas/were + done
一般将来时will dowill be + done
过去将来时would dowould be + done
现在进行时am/is/are doingam/is/are + being + done
过去进行时was/were doingwas/were + being + done
现在完成时have/has donehave/has + been + done
过去完成时had donehad + been + done

三个最容易错的格子：① 将来时的 be 不能丢（will be done）；② 进行时的 being 不能丢（is being done）；③ 完成时的 been 不能丢（has been done）。

做题套路：先在原句里圈出时态标志（every day / yesterday / tomorrow / now / so far / before + 过去时……），确定 be 的形状；再看新主语的单复数（is / are，has / have）；最后把动词换成过去分词。

下面的练习就是讲义里的「具体范例」表——同一间教室、八种时态各填一空，填完正好把整张万能表走一遍。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习：补全具体范例（讲义 p4——八种时态各一空）

general_qs.stem:
Students clean the classroom every day.
The classroom __________ __________ by students every day.
general_qs.explain: every day → 一般现在时；the classroom 单数 → is cleaned。

general_qs.stem:
Students cleaned the classroom yesterday.
The classroom __________ __________ by students yesterday.
general_qs.explain: yesterday → 一般过去时；教室单数 → was cleaned。

general_qs.stem:
Students will clean the classroom tomorrow.
The classroom __________ __________ __________ by students tomorrow.
general_qs.explain: tomorrow → 一般将来时 → will be cleaned，will 后的 be 不能丢。

general_qs.stem:
Students would clean the classroom.
The classroom __________ __________ __________ by students.
general_qs.explain: would clean 过去将来时 → would be cleaned。

general_qs.stem:
Students are cleaning the classroom now.
The classroom __________ __________ __________ by students now.
general_qs.explain: now + are cleaning → 现在进行时被动 is being cleaned，being 不能丢。

general_qs.stem:
Students were cleaning the classroom at 5 p.m. yesterday.
The classroom __________ __________ __________ by students at 5 p.m. yesterday.
general_qs.explain: at 5 p.m. yesterday + were cleaning → 过去进行时被动 was being cleaned。

general_qs.stem:
Students have cleaned the classroom.
The classroom __________ __________ __________ by students.
general_qs.explain: have cleaned → 现在完成时被动；新主语 the classroom 单数 → has been cleaned（不是 have！）。

general_qs.stem:
Students had cleaned the classroom before the teacher arrived.
The classroom __________ __________ __________ by students before the teacher arrived.
general_qs.explain: had cleaned（在老师来之前更早完成）→ 过去完成时被动 had been cleaned。时间从句保持不变。

nodes.title: ⑤ 什么时候用被动：常见用法
nodes.explain:
什么时候该用被动？常见六种情况：

用法例句
不知道或不必说执行者（省略 by）My bike was stolen last night. 我的自行车昨晚被偷了。
You will be punished if you cut down a tree.
强调执行者（用 by 短语）The book was written by Jane Austen. 这本书是简·奥斯汀写的。
执行者是泛指（people、one 等）The boy is called Tom. 这个男孩叫汤姆。
强调承受者She is liked by everyone in our class. 班里每个人都喜欢她。
陈述客观事实（科技、新闻报道）Oil is found deep in the ground. 在地下深处发现石油。
Drinking tea is seen as a healthy lifestyle in China.
习惯上只用于被动He was born in Hubei in 1518. 他 1518 年出生在湖北。
Rome was not built in a day. 罗马不是一天建成的。

记住：be born（出生）永远是被动——「被生下来」，考频极高。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习 2：选择最佳答案（讲义原题）

general_qs.stem: You ________ on the phone.
general_qs.explain: 打电话找人惯用被动：「有人找你接电话」。主语 you 是「被找」的承受者，现在时 → are wanted。B 形式错（want 的过去分词是 wanted）。

general_qs.stem: Everything ________ away.
general_qs.explain: everything 是单数 → has；东西「被拿走」→ 被动 has been taken。B 主动方向错；C took 是过去式不是过去分词；D were 数错。

general_qs.stem: These books ________ for children.
general_qs.explain: books 复数 + 表用途的一般现在 → are written（这些书是写给儿童看的）。A has 数错；C/D 主动方向错。

general_qs.stem: You ________ many times not to make the same mistakes.
general_qs.explain: many times 到现在为止 → 现在完成时；you 是「被提醒」的 → 被动 have been told。

general_qs.stem: The first electric railway ________ in 1890.
general_qs.explain: in 1890 明确过去时间 → 一般过去时被动 was opened。A 时态错；B 缺过去分词；C 完成时不能与具体过去时间连用。

general_qs.stem: A new hospital ________ in our city soon.
general_qs.explain: soon → 将来时；医院是「被建」的 → will be built。A 主动方向错。

general_qs.stem: When and where ________ you ________?
general_qs.explain: be born 惯用被动；主语 you → be 用 were。出生是过去的事，用 were born。

general_qs.stem: You ________ if you cut down a tree.
general_qs.explain: if 从句用一般现在时，主句用将来时（主将从现）；you「被惩罚」→ will be punished。

general_qs.stem: The computer ________ now.
general_qs.explain: now → 现在进行时；电脑「正在被修」→ is being repaired。C 缺 is；A 不是进行时。

general_qs.stem: All the work ________ before his parents arrived.
general_qs.explain: before his parents arrived 是过去时，工作完成在它之前（过去的过去）→ 过去完成时被动 had been finished。work 不可数，谓语单数。

nodes.title: ⑥ 综合验收：八题混排自查
nodes.explain:
最后一关，把这一讲学过的东西混在一起考：每题给了动词原形（括号里），先判断该不该用被动，再按第 ④ 关的万能表写出完整形式。

做题三步：① 圈时间/时态标志（in 1937 / now / So far / He said… / before…）；② 判断主语与动词的关系——主语是承受者就用被动；③ 套万能表写出 be done，检查 be / being / been 有没有丢。

8 题对 6 题以上就算过关；做错的题记下来，过两天回来重做一遍。

说明：这一讲的作业卷会留到课后当考试检验，所以这里不会出现作业卷原题——放心练，不会「剧透」。
nodes.qs_label: 综合验收（用所给动词的适当形式填空）

general_qs.stem: Rice ________ (grow) in the south of China.
general_qs.explain: 客观事实 → 一般现在时；大米「被种植」→ is grown。

general_qs.stem: The bridge ________ (build) in 1937 and is still in use.
general_qs.explain: in 1937 明确过去时间 → 一般过去时被动 was built。

general_qs.stem: Look! The new library ________ (build) now.
general_qs.explain: Look! + now → 现在进行时；图书馆「正在被建」→ is being built，being 不能丢。

general_qs.stem: So far, more than 100 trees ________ (plant) along the river.
general_qs.explain: So far → 现在完成时；trees 复数 → have；「被种下」→ have been planted，been 不能丢。

general_qs.stem: He said the sports meeting ________ (hold) the next Friday.
general_qs.explain: He said → 宾语从句用过去将来时；运动会「被举行」→ would be held。hold 的过去分词 held 不规则。

general_qs.stem: When I got home, the dinner ________ already ________ (cook).
general_qs.explain: 到家时晚饭「已经被做好」——过去的过去 → 过去完成时被动 had been cooked。

general_qs.stem: This song ________ (sing) all over the country.
general_qs.explain: 普遍现状 → 一般现在时；歌「被唱」→ is sung。sing 的过去分词 sung 不规则。

general_qs.stem: English ________ (speak) in many countries.
general_qs.explain: 客观事实 → 一般现在时被动 is spoken。speak 的过去分词 spoken 不规则。
